title: Kettlebell Halo
summary: A slow circle of a light bell around your head. It's mainly a shoulder warm-up and builds little muscle.

muscles.why: Library rating 0.3 for front delts (minor): each working set adds 0.3 of a set to the weekly front delts total.
Library rating 0.2 for traps: below the counting floor, so it adds nothing to the weekly traps total.
Library rating 0.2 for abs: below the counting floor, so it adds nothing to the weekly abs total.

setup.text: Hold the bell by the horns upside down at your chest.
Circle it around your head, keeping it close.

form_cues.cue: Circle the bell around your head
Keep your ribs down and stay tall.

mistakes.text: Arching the back as the bell passes behind you.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train pain-free.

alternatives.why: Swap sheet: Less isolation, One side at a time, More systemic fatigue.
Swap sheet: Less isolation, More systemic fatigue, Heavier loading potential.
